card.name: Punctuation before a second drug name
card.fires_on: Commas, 'versus', 'given' or an opening parenthesis that come right after a drug name, just before another drug name such as heparin or clopidogrel is listed or compared.

modes.label: Comma in drug list
modes.description: A comma after a drug in a list of anticoagulants or interacting drugs, before the next drug name.

modes.label: Comparison word
modes.description: A word like 'versus' or 'given' that sets up a comparison drug in trial results.

modes.label: Parenthesis after drug
modes.description: An opening parenthesis after a drug name in an interaction table, before the enzyme note.

card.plain: It fires at the small joining mark after one drug name, where another drug name is expected to follow.
